scientific_integrity: The proof uses classical finite-component Poisson limits and bounded-degree Hanf locality, with the new synthesis in exact rational-exponential logical probabilities and dense limiting spectrum. The finite checker does not prove convergence.
scientific_limitations: Fixed first-order sentences in the language of two unary functions only; no explicit convergence rate. Poisson component laws and Hanf locality are prior work. General historic combinatorial limit-law criteria may imply a part of the logical statement. Independent verification has not been performed.
title: A dense arithmetic first-order limit spectrum for two random involutions
